66376-young-musgrave.title: Young Musgrave
66376-young-musgrave.creator: Unknown
66376-young-musgrave.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It would be difficult to say how Penninghame Castle had got that imposing name. It was an old house standing almost on the roadside, at least at the termination of a rough country road leading from the village, which widened into a square space at the side of the house.

arxiv-1809-08903.title: Athena X-IFU synthetic observations of galaxy clusters to probe the chemical enrichment of the Universe
arxiv-1809-08903.creator: E. Cucchetti, E. Pointecouteau, P. Peille, N. Clerc, E. Rasia, V. Biffi, S. Borgani, L. Tornatore, K. Dolag, M. Roncarelli, M. Gaspari, S. Ettori, E. Bulbul, T. Dauser, J. Wilms, F. Pajot, D. Barret
arxiv-1809-08903.description: Abstract Answers to the metal production of the Universe can be found in galaxy clusters, notably within their Intra-Cluster Medium (ICM). The X-ray Integral Field Unit ( X-IFU ) on board the next-generation European X-ray observatory Athena (2030s) will provide the necessary leap forward in spatially-resolved spectroscopy required to disentangle the intricate mechanisms responsible for this chemical enrichment.

arxiv-2105-01416.title: Performance of the ATLAS Level-1 topological trigger in Run 2
arxiv-2105-01416.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-2105-01416.description: Abstract During LHC Run 2 (2015–2018) the ATLAS Level-1 topological trigger allowed efficient data-taking by the ATLAS experiment at luminosities up to 2.1 × \times 10 34 cm -2 s -1 , which exceeds the design value by a factor of two. The system was installed in 2016 and operated in 2017 and 2018.

arxiv-2107-06442.title: GREN: Graph-Regularized Embedding Network for Weakly-Supervised Disease Localization in X-ray Images
arxiv-2107-06442.creator: Baolian Qi, Gangming Zhao, Xin Wei, Changde Du, Chengwei Pan, Yizhou Yu, Jinpeng Li
arxiv-2107-06442.description: Abstract Locating diseases in chest X-ray images with few careful annotations saves large human effort. Recent works approached this task with innovative weakly-supervised algorithms such as multi-instance learning (MIL) and class activation maps (CAM), however, these methods often yield inaccurate or incomplete regions.

arxiv-2201-07905.title: CPTAM: Constituency Parse Tree Aggregation Method
arxiv-2201-07905.creator: Adithya Kulkarni, Nasim SabetpourAlexey MarkinOliver EulensteinQi Li{aditkulk, nasim, amarkin, oeulenst, qli}@iastate.eduIowa State University, Ames, Iowa, USA
arxiv-2201-07905.description: Abstract Diverse Natural Language Processing tasks employ constituency parsing to understand the syntactic structure of a sentence according to a phrase structure grammar. Many state-of-the-art constituency parsers are proposed, but they may provide different results for the same sentences, especially for corpora outside their training domains.

arxiv-2208-12191.title: Turning Mathematics Problems into Games: Reinforcement Learning and Gröbner bases together solve Integer Feasibility Problems
arxiv-2208-12191.creator: Yue Wu, Jesús A. De Loera
arxiv-2208-12191.description: Abstract Can agents be trained to answer difficult mathematical questions by playing a game? We consider the integer feasibility problem , a challenge of deciding whether a system of linear equations and inequalities has a solution with integer values. This is a famous NP-complete problem with applications in many areas of Mathematics and Computer Science.

arxiv-2212-02524.title: Analytic bootstrap for the localized magnetic field
arxiv-2212-02524.creator: Lorenzo Bianchi
arxiv-2212-02524.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Lorenzo Bianchi. We study the two-point function of local operators in the critical O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) model in the presence of a magnetic field localized on a line. We use a recently developed conformal dispersion relation to compute the correlator at first order in the ϵ \epsilon -expansion and we extract the full set of defect and bulk CFT data using the Lorentzian inversion formulae.

arxiv-2306-11597.title: Fluid Dynamical Description of Sine-Gordon Solitons
arxiv-2306-11597.creator: Nematollah Riazi, Marzieh Peyravi
arxiv-2306-11597.description: Abstract We present a fluid dynamical description of a relativistic scalar field in 1 + 1 1+1 dimensions and apply the general results to the special case of Sine-Gordon solitons. The results which include the local quantities pressure, density and fluid velocity are compared to the standard quantities attributed to the solitons. pacs 05.45.Yv, 03.75.Lm, 43.25.Rq, 47.35.

arxiv-2309-14557.title: Disruption Detection for a Cognitive Digital Supply Chain Twin Using Hybrid Deep Learning
arxiv-2309-14557.creator: Mahmoud Ashraf, Amr Eltawil, Islam Ali
arxiv-2309-14557.description: Abstract Purpose: Recent disruptive events, such as COVID-19 and Russia-Ukraine conflict, had a significant impact of global supply chains. Digital supply chain twins have been proposed in order to provide decision makers with an effective and efficient tool to mitigate disruption impact.

arxiv-2310-01207.title: Learn to Follow: Decentralized Lifelong Multi-agent Pathfinding via Planning and Learning
arxiv-2310-01207.creator: Alexey Skrynnik, Anton Andreychuk, Maria Nesterova, Konstantin Yakovlev, Aleksandr Panov
arxiv-2310-01207.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alexey Skrynnik, Anton Andreychuk, Maria Nesterova, Konstantin Yakovlev, Aleksandr Panov. Multi-agent Pathfinding (MAPF) problem generally asks to find a set of conflict-free paths for a set of agents confined to a graph and is typically solved in a centralized fashion.

arxiv-2503-02921.title: Applications of Entropy in Data Analysis and Machine Learning: A Review
arxiv-2503-02921.creator: Salomé A. Sepúveda Fontaine, José M. Amigó
arxiv-2503-02921.description: Abstract Since its origin in the thermodynamics of the 19th century, the concept of entropy has also permeated other fields of physics and mathematics, such as Classical and Quantum Statistical Mechanics, Information Theory, Probability Theory, Ergodic Theory and the Theory of Dynamical Systems. Specifically, we are referring to the classical entropies: the Boltzmann-Gibbs, von Neumann, Shannon, Kolmogorov-Sinai and topological entropies.

arxiv-2506-17148.title: Shock formation in 1D conservation laws I: Inviscid structure
arxiv-2506-17148.creator: John Anderson, Sanchit Chaturvedi, Cole Graham
arxiv-2506-17148.description: Abstract . We study the stability and structure of shock formation in 1D hyperbolic conservation laws. We show that shock formation is stable near shocking simple waves: perturbations form a shock nearby in spacetime. We also characterize the boundary of the classical development in a spacetime neighborhood of the first time singularity.

arxiv-2512-14779.title: Evaluating Weather Forecasts from a Decision Maker’s Perspective
arxiv-2512-14779.creator: Kornelius Raeth Nicole Ludwig
arxiv-2512-14779.description: Abstract Standard weather forecast evaluations focus on the forecaster’s perspective and on a statistical assessment comparing forecasts and observations. In practice, however, forecasts are used to make decisions, so it seems natural to take the decision-maker’s perspective and quantify the value of a forecast by its ability to improve decision-making.

Increases in non-vaccine-serotype (NVT) IPD rates occurred in some site

europmc-pmc5549999.creator: Eastman P, Swails J, Chodera JD, McGibbon RT, Zhao Y, Beauchamp KA, Wang LP, Simmonett AC, Harrigan MP, Stern CD, Wiewiora RP, Brooks BR, Pande VS.

pmc-10541882.title: Skin microbiota secretomes modulate cutaneous innate immunity against Borrelia burgdorferi s.s
pmc-10541882.creator: F Baquer, B Jaulhac, C Barthel, M Paz, J Wolfgramm, A Müller, N Boulanger, A Grillon
pmc-10541882.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In Lyme borreliosis, the skin constitutes a major interface for the host, the bacteria and the tick. Skin immunity is provided by specialized immune cells but also by the resident cells: the keratinocytes and the fibroblasts. Discoveries on the role of the microbiome in the modulation of skin inflammation and immunity have reinforced the potential importance of the skin in vector-borne diseases.

pmc-10711247.title: Dienogest in endometriosis treatment: A narrative literature review
pmc-10711247.creator: Joowon Lee, Hyeon Ji Park, Kyong Wook Yi
pmc-10711247.description: Endometriosis is characterized by the implantation of endometrial cells outside the uterus. This hormone-dependent disease is highly prevalent among women of reproductive age. Clinical symptoms of endometriosis include dysmenorrhea, pelvic pain, and infertility, which can negatively impact the overall quality of life of those affected.

pmc-11270947.title: Effect of exercise on cluneal nerve entrapment neuropathy: a case report
pmc-11270947.creator: Burcu Özüberk, Mine Argalı Deniz, Feray Cinevre Soyupek
pmc-11270947.description: BackgroundLow back pain is an important disability problem frequently encountered in the clinic. In the literature, it has been shown that neuropathic pain in chronic low back pain is quite common in patients. Although superior cluneal nerve entrapment syndrome is an underdiagnosed cause of low back and leg pain, differential diagnosis is very important anatomically and clinically.

pmc-11331752.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A material to be used to fabricate any of these devices should possess an array of properties, which include biocompatibility, no toxicity, bioactivity, low wear rate, low to moderate incidence of artifacts during imaging, tensile strength and modulus that are comparable to those of cortical bone, high fatigue strength/long fatigue life, minimal or no negative impact on radiotherapy (RT) planning and delivery, and

pmc-11400986.title: Partial nephrectomy without prior arterial embolization in a case of giant renal angiomyolipoma
pmc-11400986.creator: Yamen Al Ahmad, Khaled T Dardeer, Akram Wafiq Abo Daken
pmc-11400986.description: Introduction and importanceThis is a case of giant renal angiomyolipoma treated with partial nephrectomy without pre-embolization of the supplying arteries.Case presentationThe patient presented for regular checkup, a mass in the left flank was found on examination. No other symptoms were present. No history of medical or surgical importance was found.

pmc-11519572.title: Characterization and source apportionment of water-soluble ion pollution in PM10 of typical cities in northern China
pmc-11519572.creator: Guojun Han, Mingzhu He, Zhiheng Du, Nanxin Wei, Haiping Luo
pmc-11519572.description: SummaryUnderstanding the characteristics and sources of water-soluble ion pollution in particulate matter is crucial for preventing, controlling, and managing air pollution. In this study, we analyzed the pollution characteristics and sources of water-soluble ions in PM10 in three typical cities in northern China.

pmc-13526770.creator: Ayesha Shafique, Mohammad Siraj, Sadia Din, Saif A Alsaif, Khalid Haseeb, Benmao Cheng

pmc-13559075.title: Stage-associated differences in injury and stress responses of hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes under macrophage-derived inflammatory stimulation
pmc-13559075.creator: Wei Jing, Qingbin Liu, Xiaoyi Chang, Yuna Zhang, Jing Li
pmc-13559075.description: BackgroundMacrophage-driven inflammation contributes to myocardial injury in pediatric myocarditis, but the extent to which cardiomyocyte maturation status influences responses to inflammatory stimulation remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate stage-associated differences in human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs) exposed to THP-1 macrophage-derived conditioned media and to explore the involvement of stress-response pathways.
